annotations.title: Recent 8-K material events from SEC EDGAR

description: Recent Form 8-K current reports (material corporate events) for a ticker or CIK over the last 1 to 365 days: filing date, event date, accession number, document URL and item numbers decoded to their Form 8-K titles (1.01 material agreement, 2.02 earnings results, 5.02 director or officer changes, 7.01 Reg FD, 8.01 other events and more), plus counts by item. Source: SEC EDGAR submissions API. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, 1 to 10 digits. Mutually exclusive with ticker.

days.description: Look-back window in days, 1 to 365 (default 90): 8-Ks filed on or after today minus days (Eastern Time).

limit.description: 8-K filings to list, 1 to 50 (default 20), newest first. Item counts cover the whole window.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B. Mutually exclusive with cik.

name: sec_events
title: Recent 8-K material events from SEC EDGAR
